name: bisulfite-dmr-analysis-workflow
description: Use when paired-end whole-genome bisulfite sequencing reads must be mapped, reduced to six-column per-CpG methylated and unmethylated count tables, aggregated into regional total and methylated counts, and tested between externally defined groups.

name: chipseq-peak-motif-discovery-workflow
description: Use when paired ChIP-seq immunoprecipitation and control FASTQ reads must be aligned and quality-assessed, converted into control-aware peaks, and analyzed for over-represented sequence motifs against an explicit matched background.
